verdict.rationale: E2B docs explicitly state sandboxes have outbound internet access by default and this can be controlled via a simple on/off switch or fine-grained allow/deny lists, directly matching the platform-engineer's need for explicit egress policy. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of the allow/deny list mechanics, and no detail on policy granularity (e.g., per-domain vs per-IP) or enforcement scope.
